value: 用来控制携带数据. 当key 为 `&` 值为 `$` 时, 将所有原始数据打平设置到 data 中. 当值为 $ 将所有原始数据赋值到对应的 key 中. 当值为 $ 打头时, 将变量值设置到 key 中.
translation: Used to control carrying data. When the key is `&` and the value is `$`, all original data will be set to data flatly. When the value is $, all original data will be assigned to the corresponding key. When the value starts with $, the variable value will be set to key.

translation: evalMode is the expression directly, otherwise ${this is the expression} is required. The default is true.

value: 混合模式，意味着这个输入框既可以输入不同文本 也可以输入公式。 当输入公式时，值格式为  其他内容当字符串。
translation: Mixed mode means that this input box can input different text or formulas. When entering a formula, the value format is ${formula content} and other contents are treated as strings.

translation: By default, direct downloading will be supported when the file path is displayed, and prefixes such as `http://xx.dom/filename=` can be supported. If you do not want this, you can set the current configuration item to `false`. \n\nVersion 1.1.6 starts to support variables  to piece together a download address, and supports configuration as post.

value:
配置刷新动作，这个动作通常在完成渲染器本省的固定动作后出发。

一般用来配置目标组件的 name 属性。多个目标可以用逗号隔开。

当目标是 windows 时表示刷新整个页面。

刷新目标的同时还支持传递参数如： `foo?a=&b=,boo?c=`
translation:
Configure the refresh action. This action usually starts after completing the fixed action of the renderer itself. 

Generally used to configure the name attribute of the target component. Multiple targets can be separated by commas. 

When the target is windows, it means refreshing the entire page. 

While refreshing the target, it also supports passing parameters such as: `foo?a=&b=,boo?c=`

value: 复制的时候用来配置复制映射的数据。默认值是 {&:$}，相当与复制整个行数据 通常有时候需要用来标记是复制过来的，也可能需要删掉一下主键字段。
translation: Used to configure replication mapping data during replication. The default value is {&:$}, which is equivalent to copying the entire row of data. Sometimes it is necessary to mark that it was copied, and it may also be necessary to delete the primary key field.
